verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph docs clearly document a driveItem REST API with upload (put-content, createUploadSession), search/list (search, delta), versioning and sharing-link endpoints, confirming a documented API distinct from the desktop client, addressing files-api theme well for upload/list. However the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation citations for download, move, or delete endpoints, and no independent/hands-on developer corroboration of using the API for full CRUD lifecycle is present. Missing for 10: explicit download endpoint docs, explicit move endpoint docs, explicit delete endpoint docs, independent corroboration of API usage.
